title: ligularia yunnanensis
intro: Ligularia yunnanensis, commonly known as the 'Golden Ray', is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Ligularia yunnanensis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce pain, fever, and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
